key.name: theme-variant
key.description: Controls whether the MacUX theme follows the system colour scheme or is forced to a specific variant. Valid values: 'auto', 'light', 'dark'.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Hex colour string used as the primary accent throughout the MacUX theme (buttons, focus rings, active states). Example: '#0071e3'.

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Which screen edge the Dock attaches to. Valid values: 'bottom', 'left', 'right'.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: Base icon size in pixels. Magnification adds up to 30 % on top.

key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: When true, the Dock slides off-screen when a window covers it and reappears when the cursor approaches the screen edge.

key.name: dock-magnification
key.description: When true, icons near the cursor grow proportionally as the cursor approaches them (macOS-style Dock magnification).

key.name: menu-bar-enabled
key.description: When true, the GNOME Shell top panel is replaced by the MacUX global menu bar which shows the focused application's menu.

key.name: macux-spotlight
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight search.

key.name: macux-launchpad
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the Launchpad app grid.

key.name: macux-mission-control
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to show Mission Control (all windows).

key.name: macux-notification-center
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the Notification Center panel.

key.name: macux-control-center
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the Control Center panel.

key.name: macux-show-desktop
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to minimise all windows and show the desktop.
